title: 鋼拱橋拱肋合龍~Steel arch rib closure
focus: 從懸臂半拱到完整拱的體系轉換：扣索控制、溫度窗口、合龍段接合與卸載監測~The system change from cantilevered half-arches to a complete arch: tieback control, temperature windows, closure joints and release monitoring
summary: 大跨度鋼拱多半以兩側半拱懸臂伸出、在拱頂合龍的方式架設，合龍是整個施工中結構體系改變最劇烈、對幾何與溫度最敏感的時刻。本課以雪梨港灣大橋 1930 年放索合龍、新河峽大橋 1976 年以 16 具千斤頂下放合龍，以及上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設為例，說明合龍前後的力學、架設方法選擇、合龍段構造、溫度場、線形調整、鎖定時機、扣索卸載與驗收，最後談強迫對位的風險與合龍紀錄的交接。~Most long-span steel arches are built by cantilevering half-arches from both sides and closing them at the crown, and closure is the moment of the most drastic system change in the whole erection, the most sensitive to geometry and temperature. Using the 1930 cable-release closure of Sydney Harbour Bridge, the 1976 jack-down closure of New River Gorge Bridge with 16 jacks and the temporary cable-stayed cantilevering of Shanghai's Lupu Bridge, the course explains the mechanics before and after closure, choice of erection method, closure-segment detailing, temperature fields, geometry adjustment, locking time, tieback release and acceptance, ending with the risks of forced fit and the handover of closure records.

units.anchor: 合龍前後的體系轉換~System change at closure
units.title: 合龍的力學意義~What closure means structurally
units.mechanism: 合龍前，每個半拱都是從拱腳伸出的懸臂，自重在拱腳產生很大的傾覆彎矩，必須由扣索、背拉索或臨時支架承擔；合龍後，兩個半拱在拱頂互相頂住，荷載改以軸壓沿拱軸傳到拱腳，並在拱腳產生水平推力。同一批鋼構件在合龍前後的受力方式完全不同：懸臂狀態下上弦受拉、下弦受壓且彎矩很大，成拱後以軸壓為主。合龍與之後的扣索卸載，就是把荷載從臨時系統轉移到永久拱體系的過程，順序與量值都必須受控。~Before closure each half-arch is a cantilever from its springing, and its self-weight creates a large overturning moment at the foot that tiebacks, backstays or temporary falsework must resist; after closure the two halves bear against each other at the crown, loads travel as axial compression along the arch axis to the springings, and horizontal thrust appears there. The same steel members carry load entirely differently before and after: as a cantilever the top chord is in tension, the bottom chord in compression and bending is large, while the completed arch works mainly in axial compression. Closure and the subsequent tieback release transfer load from the temporary system to the permanent arch, so both sequence and magnitudes must be controlled.
units.model: 以 L = 300 m、f = 60 m、w = 150 kN/m 的拱為例：成拱後推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN。合龍前半拱懸臂長 150 m，拱腳彎矩 M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 150×150²/2 ≈ 1.69×10⁶ kN·m；若扣索對拱腳的力臂 40 m，扣索力 T ≈ 1.69×10⁶/40 ≈ 42,200 kN。數值為教學假設。~For an arch with L = 300 m, f = 60 m and w = 150 kN/m, the completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 150×300²/(8×60) ≈ 28,125 kN. Before closure each half is a 150 m cantilever with a foot moment M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 150×150²/2 ≈ 1.69×10⁶ kN·m; with a 40 m tieback lever arm about the foot, the tieback force is T ≈ 1.69×10⁶/40 ≈ 42,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段分析逐步計算每一安裝階段、合龍與卸載各步驟的桿件力、扣索力與線形，並確認每個構件在最不利的臨時狀態下仍有足夠容量；分析模型須經獨立審查，作為施工監控的預測基準。~Use staged analysis to compute member forces, tieback forces and geometry for every erection stage, the closure and each release step, confirming every member has capacity in its worst temporary state; the model is independently checked and becomes the prediction baseline for construction monitoring.
units.failure: 若只依完工狀態設計構件而未檢查懸臂狀態，上弦在懸臂期受拉、下弦受到遠大於完工時的壓力，可能在架設中挫屈或連接破壞；卸載順序錯誤時，荷載可能瞬間集中到少數構件。~Designing members only for the completed state without checking the cantilever stage can leave top chords in tension and bottom chords under far more compression than in service, risking buckling or connection failure during erection; a wrong release sequence can suddenly concentrate load on a few members.
units.misconception: 鋼拱在架設過程中一直都是拱，構件受力和完工後一樣。~A steel arch behaves as an arch throughout erection, so members carry the same forces as in service.
units.practice: 設計單位應提供完整的施工階段分析與每階段的允許值，施工者不得自行改變架設或卸載順序；任何順序變更須重新分析並經設計者書面核准，合龍與卸載列為主要停留點。~The designer should supply a full staged analysis with permissible values for each stage, and the contractor may not change erection or release sequences on its own; any change needs re-analysis and written approval by the designer, with closure and release as principal hold points.

units.anchor: 扣索與背拉系統~Tieback and stay systems
units.title: 架設方法與臨時支撐的選擇~Choosing the erection method and temporary support
units.mechanism: 鋼拱的架設方法取決於地形、水域與跨度。雪梨港灣大橋在港灣上無法設支架，於兩岸岩盤開挖隧道錨碇 128 條鋼索拉住半拱；新河峽大橋在 267 公尺深的峽谷中以纜索吊運送構件，並以油井套管背拉索錨碇在拱腳後方約 200 英尺的地錨；上海盧浦大橋則以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設 550 公尺的拱。這些方法的共同點是：臨時系統必須提供與半拱自重相當的抗傾覆能力，而且其彈性伸長會直接影響半拱端點的位置，所以扣索既是承力構件，也是調整線形的工具。~Erection method depends on terrain, water and span. Sydney Harbour Bridge could have no falsework over the harbour, so 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels held back the half-arches; New River Gorge Bridge, over a gorge 267 m deep, used a cableway to deliver steel and oil-well-casing tiebacks anchored in deadmen about 200 ft behind the springings; Shanghai's Lupu Bridge cantilevered its 550 m arch on temporary cable stays. In every case the temporary system must provide overturning resistance comparable to the half-arch's weight, and its elastic stretch directly moves the half-arch tip, so tiebacks are both load-carrying members and tools for adjusting geometry.
units.model: 扣索彈性伸長 δ = T·L/(E·A)。T = 42.2 MN、扣索長 L = 200 m、E = 195 GPa、斷面 A = 0.03 m²：δ = 42.2×10⁶×200/(195×10⁹×0.03) ≈ 1.44 m；若 A 加倍為 0.06 m²，δ ≈ 0.72 m。扣索伸長會使半拱繞拱腳轉動，端點下沉，必須在預拱或扣索長度中補償。數值為教學假設。~Tieback stretch δ = T·L/(E·A). With T = 42.2 MN, length L = 200 m, E = 195 GPa and A = 0.03 m², δ = 42.2×10⁶×200/(195×10⁹×0.03) ≈ 1.44 m; doubling A to 0.06 m² gives δ ≈ 0.72 m. The stretch rotates the half-arch about its foot and drops the tip, so it must be compensated in camber or tieback length. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 扣索系統的錨碇（岩盤隧道、地錨或塔架）在使用前做驗證拉拔試驗，扣索張拉時記錄油壓、伸長量與溫度；每階段量測半拱端點位置，與包含扣索伸長的施工分析比較，差異超過允差時先查明原因再繼續。~Proof-test tieback anchorages (rock tunnels, deadmen or towers) before use and record jack pressure, elongation and temperature during stressing; survey the half-arch tip at every stage against a staged analysis that includes tieback stretch, and investigate before continuing whenever the difference exceeds tolerance.
units.failure: 若低估扣索伸長或錨碇位移，半拱端點逐段下沉，合龍時兩端高程差遠超可調整範圍；錨碇失效則可能使半拱失去平衡而倒塌，是拱橋架設中最嚴重的風險之一。~Underestimating tieback stretch or anchorage movement lets the half-arch tip sink stage by stage until the closure level difference far exceeds the adjustable range; an anchorage failure can unbalance and collapse the half-arch, one of the gravest risks in arch erection.
units.misconception: 扣索只要強度夠就好，它的伸長量不會影響拱的線形。~Tiebacks only need enough strength; their stretch does not affect the arch geometry.
units.practice: 架設方案應比較支架、扣索懸臂、纜索吊運、轉體與大段提升等方法的風險與成本，選定後由獨立工程師審查臨時系統；扣索錨碇的驗證試驗與每階段量測列為停留點。~The erection scheme should compare falsework, tieback cantilevering, cableway, rotation and large-segment lifting for risk and cost, with the chosen temporary system independently checked; anchorage proof tests and stage-by-stage surveys are hold points.

units.anchor: 合龍段與拼接板~Closure segment and splice plates
units.title: 合龍段構造與高強度螺栓接合~Closure-segment detailing and HS bolting
units.mechanism: 合龍段是填補兩個半拱端點之間間隙的構件，構造上常見的做法有三種：先量測實際間隙再現場切割或配製的配合段；預留長孔或可調墊板的螺栓拼接；以及先以臨時銷或鎖定裝置接合、再焊接或鎖緊的分步作法。歷史上雪梨港灣大橋以鉚接完成拱頂接合，現代鋼拱多採高強度螺栓摩擦接合或全滲透焊接。合龍段必須在很短的時間內完成連接，並在接合後立刻能承受成拱後的軸壓與溫度變化造成的附加力。~A closure segment fills the gap between the two half-arch tips, typically in one of three ways: a fitting piece cut or made to the measured gap; a bolted splice with slotted holes or adjustable shims; or a staged connection locked first by temporary pins or locking devices and then welded or fully bolted. Historically Sydney Harbour Bridge completed its crown joint by riveting, while modern steel arches mostly use slip-critical high-strength bolting or full-penetration welds. The closure must be connected in a short time and, once joined, immediately carry the completed arch's axial compression and the extra forces from temperature change.
units.model: 摩擦型接合的抗滑力 R = n_s·μ·F_p。M24、10.9 級螺栓預拉力 F_p = 0.7×1,040×353 ≈ 257 kN，兩個摩擦面 n_s = 2、μ = 0.5：每顆約 2×0.5×257 ≈ 257 kN。若合龍接頭需傳遞 20,000 kN 而不滑動，需要 20,000/257 ≈ 78 顆螺栓。等級與 μ 為教學假設。~Slip resistance of a friction joint R = n_s·μ·F_p. An M24 grade 10.9 bolt has preload F_p = 0.7×1,040×353 ≈ 257 kN; with two slip planes n_s = 2 and μ = 0.5, each bolt resists about 2×0.5×257 ≈ 257 kN. A closure joint that must carry 20,000 kN without slip needs 20,000/257 ≈ 78 bolts. Grade and μ are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 合龍段製作前以多次量測（不同溫度）決定配合尺寸，接觸面依規定處理並量測摩擦係數試片；螺栓以轉角法或扭矩法鎖緊並抽驗預拉力，焊接合龍則以超音波檢測全滲透焊道，記錄焊接時的溫度與拱的狀態。~Before making the closure piece, measure the gap several times at different temperatures to set its dimensions; prepare faying surfaces as specified and test slip-coefficient coupons; tighten bolts by turn-of-nut or torque with preload spot-checks, and for welded closures test full-penetration welds ultrasonically, recording temperature and arch state during welding.
units.failure: 若依單次量測製作合龍段，溫度不同時尺寸不符，只能以千斤頂強迫對位；摩擦面受油污或塗料污染時抗滑力不足，接頭在成拱後滑動，使拱頂產生非預期的變形與應力重分配。~A closure piece made from a single measurement does not fit at another temperature, forcing alignment by jacks; faying surfaces contaminated by oil or paint lack slip resistance, so the joint slips once the arch carries load and the crown deforms and redistributes stress unexpectedly.
units.misconception: 合龍段只要尺寸大致吻合，用螺栓強行鎖緊就能達到設計狀態。~If the closure piece roughly fits, forcing the bolts tight achieves the design state.
units.practice: 合龍段的設計應預留調整量（長孔、墊板或可切割餘量），並在施工計畫中明訂量測次數、溫度修正與最終尺寸核定流程；螺栓或焊接的檢驗結果與合龍時溫度一併記錄，由設計代表簽認。~Closure-segment design should include adjustment (slotted holes, shims or trimming allowance), and the plan should state how many measurements, what temperature correction and who approves final dimensions; bolting or weld inspection results are recorded with the closure temperature and signed by the designer's representative.

units.title: 溫度場與日照溫差~Temperature fields and solar gradients
units.mechanism: 鋼材導熱快、熱容量小，日照下拱肋溫度在數小時內就能變化十幾度。均勻溫度變化使兩個半拱伸長或縮短，直接改變拱頂間隙；上下或左右的溫差則使拱肋彎曲，端點產生上下或側向偏移。箱形拱肋向陽的頂板可能比陰影中的底板熱好幾度，即使平均溫度不變，端點高程也會明顯改變。因此合龍前的量測必須同時記錄拱肋多個位置的鋼溫，而不是只看氣溫；量到的間隙與高差要換算回同一溫度狀態才有意義。~Steel conducts heat quickly and stores little, so arch ribs can change temperature by more than ten degrees within hours of sunshine. A uniform change lengthens or shortens the half-arches and directly alters the crown gap; a gradient top to bottom or side to side bends the rib and moves the tip up, down or sideways. In a box rib the sunlit top plate may be several degrees warmer than the shaded bottom plate, so the tip level changes markedly even when the average temperature does not. Pre-closure surveys must therefore record steel temperature at several points on the ribs rather than air temperature, and measured gaps and level differences are meaningful only when corrected to one thermal state.
units.model: 兩半拱合計弧長 320 m，均勻溫度變化 12 °C，間隙改變 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm。若拱肋深 3 m、上下溫差 5 °C，曲率 κ = α·ΔT/h = 1.2×10⁻⁵×5/3 = 2×10⁻⁵ /m；160 m 懸臂端轉角 κ·L ≈ 3.2 mrad、端點撓度 κ·L²/2 ≈ 0.256 m。數值為教學假設。~With 320 m of arc in the two halves and a uniform 12 °C change, the gap changes by ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×12 ≈ 46 mm. For a 3 m deep rib with a 5 °C top-to-bottom difference, the curvature is κ = α·ΔT/h = 1.2×10⁻⁵×5/3 = 2×10⁻⁵ /m; a 160 m cantilever tip rotates κ·L ≈ 3.2 mrad and deflects κ·L²/2 ≈ 0.256 m. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在拱肋頂板、底板與腹板布設溫度感測器，合龍前至少連續記錄一至兩個晝夜，同步量測端點三維位置；以溫度資料回歸出端點位置與平均溫度、溫差的關係，並與熱分析結果比較，用以預測合龍時段的狀態。~Install temperature sensors on rib top plates, bottom plates and webs and log at least one or two full days before closure while surveying tip positions in 3D; regress tip position against mean temperature and gradient, compare with thermal analysis and use the relation to predict conditions in the closure window.
units.failure: 若只以氣溫推估鋼溫，日照時段拱肋實際溫差被忽略，端點高程被誤判，依此調整扣索後，到夜間溫度均勻時兩端高差反而擴大；合龍若在溫差最大時鎖定，接頭會在夜間承受很大的附加彎矩。~Inferring steel temperature from air temperature ignores the real gradients in sunshine, misjudging tip levels; tiebacks adjusted on that basis leave a larger level difference once temperatures even out at night, and a closure locked at peak gradient puts large extra moments into the joint overnight.
units.misconception: 只要量氣溫就能代表拱肋的溫度狀態。~Air temperature alone represents the thermal state of the arch ribs.
units.practice: 合龍監測計畫應規定溫度感測器的位置與數量、量測頻率、資料同步方式與溫度修正方法；量測成果由監控小組每日整理，提供合龍時段預測，並經設計代表確認。~The closure monitoring plan should specify sensor locations and numbers, sampling rate, synchronisation and correction method; the monitoring team compiles results daily into a closure-window forecast confirmed by the designer's representative.

units.anchor: 扣索調整千斤頂~Tieback adjusting jacks
units.title: 合龍前的線形調整~Geometry adjustment before closure
units.mechanism: 合龍前兩個半拱端點的高程、平面位置與轉角必須同時接近設計值，否則合龍段無法在無應力狀態下接上。調整的手段主要是改變扣索或背拉索的長度與拉力：放鬆扣索使半拱繞拱腳轉動，端點下降並向中央移動；收緊則相反。新河峽大橋以背拉系統與 16 具千斤頂把兩側拱臂下放合龍，雪梨港灣大橋則以逐步放鬆錨索讓兩個半拱相接。實務上常建立影響係數矩陣，描述每根扣索變化對各端點座標的影響，再解出所需的調整量。~Before closure the two tips must approach design values in level, plan position and rotation simultaneously, or the closure segment cannot be fitted stress-free. Adjustment works mainly by changing tieback or backstay length and force: slackening a tieback rotates the half-arch about its foot, lowering the tip and moving it toward mid-span, and tightening does the reverse. New River Gorge Bridge lowered both arms to closure with its tieback system and 16 jacks, while Sydney Harbour Bridge brought its halves together by gradually releasing the anchor cables. In practice an influence-coefficient matrix describes how each tieback change moves each tip coordinate, and the required adjustments are solved from it.
units.model: 設某扣索每改變 1 MN，端點高程改變 s = 12 mm/MN。若端點需抬高 60 mm，所需扣索力增量 ΔT = 60/12 = 5 MN；若同時需要平面修正，以 2×2 影響係數矩陣聯立兩根扣索的調整量。影響係數為教學假設。~Suppose one tieback moves the tip level by s = 12 mm per MN. Raising the tip 60 mm needs ΔT = 60/12 = 5 MN; if plan correction is also needed, a 2×2 influence-coefficient matrix solves the adjustments of two tiebacks together. The influence coefficient is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以小幅試調整量測實際影響係數，與分析值比較並修正矩陣；每次調整後在相同溫度條件下量測端點座標與扣索力，確認收斂；最終位置需同時符合高程、平面與轉角的允差，才進入合龍。~Measure actual influence coefficients with small trial adjustments, compare with analysis and update the matrix; after each adjustment survey tip coordinates and tieback forces at the same thermal condition to confirm convergence; proceed to closure only when level, plan and rotation are all within tolerance.
units.failure: 若只調整高程而忽略轉角，兩端看似對齊，接上後合龍段內卻產生很大的彎矩；千斤頂不同步或單側過量放索，使拱肋扭轉、側向失穩，甚至造成扣索過載。~Adjusting level alone while ignoring rotation can make the tips look aligned yet lock large moments into the closure segment; unsynchronised jacks or over-release on one side twist the rib, threaten lateral stability or overload tiebacks.
units.misconception: 端點高程對齊就代表可以合龍，轉角與平面位置不重要。~Once tip levels match, closure can proceed; rotation and plan position do not matter.
units.practice: 調整程序應以影響係數矩陣為依據，規定每次調整的最大增量、同步要求與量測時機；千斤頂操作由專人指揮並有雙向通訊，任一扣索力或端點位移超出預警即停止，由監控小組與設計代表共同決定下一步。~The adjustment procedure should be based on the influence matrix and set maximum increments, synchronisation and survey timing; jack operation needs a single commander with two-way communication, and any tieback force or tip movement beyond alert values stops work until the monitoring team and designer decide the next step.

units.anchor: 合龍時段與臨時鎖定~Closure window and temporary locking
units.title: 合龍時機與臨時鎖定~Closure timing and temporary locking
units.mechanism: 因為間隙隨溫度持續變化，合龍通常選在溫度最穩定的時段，例如日出前後或陰天夜間，並先以臨時鎖定裝置（剛性連接件、臨時銷或楔塊）把兩端固定在一起，再進行正式的螺栓或焊接。鎖定的那一刻定義了拱的合龍溫度：之後的溫度變化都會以這個狀態為零點，在雙鉸或無鉸拱中產生溫度內力。若鎖定得太晚，溫度已經開始上升，鎖定裝置在固定過程中就承受力量，焊接中的接頭甚至可能被拉裂。~Because the gap keeps changing with temperature, closure is usually timed for the most stable period, such as around dawn or on overcast nights, and the two ends are first fixed by temporary locking devices (rigid links, temporary pins or wedges) before final bolting or welding. The moment of locking defines the arch's closure temperature: every later temperature change counts from this zero state and produces thermal forces in two-hinged or fixed arches. Locking too late, as temperatures begin to climb, loads the devices while they are being fixed and can even crack a joint mid-weld.
units.model: 日溫差振幅 8 °C 的正弦變化，最大變化率 dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h。兩半拱合計 320 m，間隙變化率 = 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×2.09 ≈ 8.0 mm/h；若鎖定允許間隙變化 3 mm，在變化最快時只有約 22 分鐘，而在溫度轉折點附近時間窗口長得多。溫度振幅為教學假設。~For a sinusoidal daily swing of amplitude 8 °C, the peak rate is dT/dt = A·ω = 8×2π/24 ≈ 2.09 °C/h. With 320 m of arc in the two halves, the gap changes at 1.2×10⁻⁵×320×2.09 ≈ 8.0 mm/h; if locking tolerates 3 mm of change, only about 22 minutes are available at the fastest rate, while near the temperature turning point the window is much longer. The amplitude is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 合龍當天以即時監測確認鋼溫、間隙與端點位置都在預定範圍，鎖定裝置就位後量測其受力或變形；鎖定完成時記錄的平均鋼溫即為合龍溫度，正式接合過程中持續監控，確認鎖定裝置受力不超過設計值。~On closure day confirm steel temperature, gap and tip positions are within planned ranges by real-time monitoring, then measure force or deformation in the locking devices once placed; the average steel temperature at locking becomes the closure temperature, and monitoring continues during final connection to confirm device forces stay within design values.
units.failure: 若因工期壓力在溫度快速上升時鎖定，鎖定裝置承受的力超過設計值而變形或破壞，兩端回彈；合龍溫度未記錄或與設計假設差異很大時，日後的溫度內力計算失去基準。~Locking under schedule pressure while temperatures rise fast can overload, deform or break the devices and let the ends spring apart; an unrecorded closure temperature, or one far from the design assumption, leaves later thermal-force calculations without a baseline.
units.misconception: 合龍可以在任何時間進行，只要工人準備好就能鎖定。~Closure can happen at any time as long as the crew is ready to lock it.
units.practice: 合龍程序應明訂可接受的合龍溫度範圍、鎖定的開始與完成條件、鎖定裝置的設計力與監測方法，以及溫度超出範圍時的延後決策權；合龍溫度與時間寫入正式紀錄並由設計代表簽認。~The closure procedure should define the acceptable closure-temperature range, start and completion conditions for locking, locking-device design forces and monitoring, and who decides to postpone if temperatures leave the range; closure temperature and time go into the formal record signed by the designer's representative.

units.anchor: 扣索卸載監測~Tieback release monitoring
units.title: 體系轉換與扣索卸載監測~System transfer and tieback release monitoring
units.mechanism: 合龍完成後，拱已經能互相頂住，但扣索仍然拉著半拱；接著要分階段放鬆扣索，讓荷載逐步轉移到拱體系，拱腳推力由零增加到設計值。雪梨港灣大橋在拱頂鉚接完成後才拆除錨索，新河峽大橋則以千斤頂控制下放過程。卸載的關鍵是對稱、分級與量測：兩側扣索要同步放鬆，避免拱受到不對稱的力；每一級都要量測拱頂高程、拱腳推力或應變與扣索殘餘力，確認結構反應與分析一致，才能進入下一級。~After closure the two halves bear on each other, but the tiebacks still hold the half-arches; they are then released in stages so load transfers progressively to the arch and springing thrust rises from zero to its design value. Sydney Harbour Bridge removed its anchor cables only after the crown was riveted, and New River Gorge Bridge controlled the lowering with jacks. Release depends on symmetry, staging and measurement: tiebacks on both sides slacken together to avoid unbalanced forces, and at each stage crown level, springing thrust or strain and residual tieback force are measured to confirm agreement with analysis before the next stage.
units.model: 若推力 H ≈ 28 MN 分 4 級轉移，每級增加約 7 MN；某弦桿面積 A = 0.25 m²，每級應力增量 Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa，對應應變 Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με，可由應變計清楚量到。分級數與面積為教學假設。~If a thrust of about 28 MN is transferred in 4 stages, each adds about 7 MN; for a chord with A = 0.25 m² the stress rises by Δσ = 7×10⁶/0.25 = 28 MPa per stage, a strain of Δε = 28/200,000 = 140 με that strain gauges can clearly detect. Stage count and area are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在拱腳、四分點與拱頂的弦桿裝設應變計，扣索端以測力計或油壓量測殘餘力，拱頂以全站儀量測高程；每級卸載後比較實測與預測的應變、高程與扣索力，差異在允差內才繼續，所有資料同步記錄溫度。~Fit strain gauges to chords at the springings, quarter points and crown, measure residual tieback force by load cells or jack pressure, and survey crown level by total station; after each stage compare measured strains, levels and forces with predictions and proceed only within tolerance, logging temperature with all data.
units.failure: 若一次大量放鬆或兩側不同步，拱體系瞬間承受不對稱荷載，可能造成拱腳支承或某些弦桿過載；量測資料未即時判讀時，異常反應在多級卸載後才被發現，已難以回復。~Releasing a large amount at once or unevenly between sides suddenly loads the arch unsymmetrically and can overload springing bearings or some chords; if data are not interpreted in real time, abnormal response is noticed only several stages later, when it is hard to reverse.
units.misconception: 合龍接上之後，扣索可以一次全部拆除，拱會自動承受全部荷載。~Once the crown is joined, all tiebacks can be removed at once and the arch will simply take the full load.
units.practice: 卸載程序應以表格列出每級的扣索放鬆量、預期的應變、高程與扣索力及允差，指定量測人員與判讀責任；任一指標超出預警值即停止並回到上一級穩定狀態，由設計者決定處置。~The release procedure should tabulate tieback slackening, expected strains, levels and forces with tolerances for each stage, naming who measures and who interprets; any indicator beyond its alert value stops work and returns to the previous stable stage while the designer decides.

units.anchor: 拱軸線形驗收~Arch axis acceptance
units.title: 合龍後驗收：線形與應力~Post-closure acceptance: geometry and stress
units.mechanism: 合龍與卸載完成後，要以量測證明拱達到設計的成橋狀態：拱軸線形（高程與平面）在允差內，各主要桿件應力與分析預測一致，拱腳推力與支承反力合理，扣索已完全卸載。拱軸偏差會在成拱後轉為附加彎矩，因為軸壓作用在偏心的位置；應力偏差則可能代表合龍時鎖入了非預期的內力。驗收結果同時是日後監測的零點，所有量測都要換算到參考溫度並記錄當時狀態。~After closure and release, measurements must prove the arch has reached its design completed state: arch axis (level and plan) within tolerance, main member stresses consistent with analysis, reasonable springing thrust and bearing reactions, and tiebacks fully released. Axis deviation turns into extra bending once the arch carries load, because axial compression acts eccentrically; stress deviations may indicate unexpected forces locked in at closure. The acceptance results are also the zero point for later monitoring, so every measurement is corrected to a reference temperature and the state at the time recorded.
units.model: 教學允差取拱軸高程偏差 ≤ L/5,000：L = 300 m 時為 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm。若實測最大偏差 42 mm，在允差內；以推力 28,125 kN 乘偏心 0.042 m，附加彎矩約 1,180 kN·m，需確認在桿件餘裕內。允差與偏差為教學假設。~Take a teaching tolerance of L/5,000 on arch-axis level: for L = 300 m that is 300/5,000 = 0.06 m = 60 mm. A measured maximum deviation of 42 mm is within it; multiplying the 28,125 kN thrust by a 0.042 m eccentricity gives about 1,180 kN·m of extra moment, to be checked against member reserves. Tolerance and deviation are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以全站儀或 GNSS 在清晨量測拱軸各控制點並做溫度修正，與設計成橋線形比較；以應變計資料計算主要桿件的累積應力，與施工階段分析的最終狀態比較；必要時以載重試驗確認勁度，結果寫入竣工報告。~Survey arch-axis control points at dawn by total station or GNSS with temperature correction and compare with the design completed profile; compute accumulated stresses in main members from strain-gauge data against the final staged-analysis state; if required confirm stiffness by load testing, and record results in the as-built report.
units.failure: 若驗收時未做溫度修正，可能把溫度造成的偏差誤判為施工誤差而進行不必要的調整，或反過來把真正的偏差掩蓋；應力資料缺失時，無法知道合龍是否鎖入了額外內力，日後評估只能以假設代替。~Without temperature correction, acceptance may mistake thermal deviation for construction error and trigger needless adjustment, or hide a real deviation; missing stress data leave no way of knowing whether closure locked in extra forces, so later assessments must rely on assumptions.
units.misconception: 拱只要外觀看起來對稱平順，就代表合龍成功。~If the arch looks symmetrical and smooth, closure was successful.
units.practice: 驗收準則（線形允差、應力差異上限、扣索殘餘力、支承狀態）應在施工前就寫入規範，由業主、設計與施工三方共同見證量測；驗收報告包含原始資料、溫度修正與判定結論，作為交接文件的核心。~Acceptance criteria for geometry tolerance, stress difference limits, residual tieback force and bearing condition should be in the specification before construction, with measurements witnessed jointly by owner, designer and contractor; the acceptance report with raw data, temperature correction and conclusions is the core of the handover file.

units.anchor: 強迫合龍鎖入力~Locked-in force from forced fit
units.title: 強迫對位與鎖入應力~Forced fit and locked-in stress
units.mechanism: 當兩端的間隙或高差超出合龍段可調整的範圍，現場常有以千斤頂強行頂開或拉近、讓螺栓孔對上的誘惑。強迫對位等於在拱中施加一個非設計的變形，合龍後這個變形被鎖住，轉為永久的附加推力與彎矩；它不會在外觀上顯現，卻會消耗桿件的承載餘裕，並在溫度與活載疊加時提早使某些桿件達到極限。正確的做法是回到量測與分析：查明偏差來源，以扣索調整、合龍段重新配製或在設計者核准下控制強迫量。~When the gap or level difference exceeds what the closure segment can absorb, the temptation on site is to jack the ends apart or together until bolt holes line up. Forcing the fit imposes an undesigned deformation on the arch that is locked in at closure and becomes permanent additional thrust and moment; it cannot be seen, yet it consumes member reserves and brings some members to their limits earlier when temperature and live load add on. The correct course is to return to measurement and analysis: identify the source of the deviation and use tieback adjustment, a remade closure piece or a forcing amount controlled with the designer's approval.
units.model: 若拱對拱頂相對水平位移的勁度 k_H = 500 MN/m，強迫拉近 Δ = 20 mm 會鎖入 ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN 的附加推力，約為設計推力 28 MN 的 36%。勁度為教學假設。~If the arch's stiffness against relative horizontal movement at the crown is k_H = 500 MN/m, forcing the ends together by Δ = 20 mm locks in ΔH = k_H·Δ = 500×0.02 = 10 MN of extra thrust, about 36% of a 28 MN design thrust. The stiffness is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 合龍前後比較應變計讀數與分析預測，若主要桿件出現與溫度及荷載無法解釋的應力差，即可能有鎖入力；千斤頂強迫對位時須記錄千斤頂力與位移，換算鎖入量並交由設計者檢核。~Compare strain readings before and after closure with predictions; stress differences in main members that temperature and load cannot explain suggest locked-in forces; if jacks force alignment, record jack forces and displacements, convert them to locked-in effects and submit them to the designer for checking.
units.failure: 未經檢核的強迫對位使某些弦桿長期處於較高應力，在極端低溫或重載時接近挫屈或連接滑動；若鎖入力未記錄，日後評估與補強都以錯誤的初始狀態計算。~Unchecked forced fit leaves some chords permanently at higher stress, close to buckling or joint slip in extreme cold or heavy load; unrecorded locked-in forces mean later assessments and strengthening start from a wrong initial state.
units.misconception: 螺栓孔對不上時，用千斤頂強行對位是正常的施工手段，不需要通報設計者。~Jacking ends into position when bolt holes do not align is routine and need not be reported to the designer.
units.practice: 施工規範應明訂強迫對位的最大允許量與必須通報的門檻，超過門檻須停止並由設計者評估；所有強迫對位的位置、千斤頂力與位移都記錄在合龍紀錄中，納入竣工資料。~The specification should set a maximum permitted forcing amount and a reporting threshold, beyond which work stops for the designer's assessment; every forced alignment's location, jack force and displacement is entered in the closure record and the as-built file.

units.anchor: 合龍紀錄與監測基準~Closure records and monitoring baseline
units.title: 合龍紀錄、基準與交接~Closure records, baselines and handover
units.mechanism: 合龍的成果最終要轉成可交接的工程資料：合龍溫度與時間、合龍段的實際尺寸與接合方式、扣索卸載過程的量測、驗收時的線形與應力，以及任何強迫對位或偏差處置。這些資料定義了拱的「零應力狀態」與初始內力，是日後評估溫度內力、補強或更換構件時不可或缺的起點。像新河峽大橋這樣在數十年後仍被詳細記錄於國家史蹟文件中的架設資料，正說明了合龍紀錄對長期管理的價值。~The results of closure must finally become handover data: closure temperature and time, actual closure-segment dimensions and connection method, measurements during tieback release, geometry and stresses at acceptance, and any forced alignment or deviation treatment. These records define the arch's stress-free state and initial internal forces, the indispensable starting point for later assessments of thermal forces, strengthening or member replacement. The detailed erection record of New River Gorge Bridge preserved decades later in its National Register documentation shows the long-term management value of closure records.
units.model: 以竣工基準建立拱頂高程—溫度回歸：斜率 4 mm/°C、參考溫度 20 °C。某年在 25 °C 量測，預期應比基準高 5×4 = 20 mm，實測卻低 10 mm，殘差 −30 mm，超出量測不確定度（約 ±5 mm）甚多，代表可能有拱腳位移或構件變化，需啟動特別檢查。數值為教學假設。~Build a crown level–temperature baseline at completion with a slope of 4 mm/°C and a reference of 20 °C. A survey at 25 °C should read 5×4 = 20 mm above baseline but reads 10 mm below, a residual of −30 mm, well beyond the measurement uncertainty of about ±5 mm, suggesting springing movement or member change and triggering a special inspection. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前核對紀錄的完整性：每個施工階段的量測、合龍與卸載的原始資料、驗收報告與所有不符合事項的處置；營運單位依基準曲線定期量測並計算殘差，殘差超出門檻時依程序通報與檢查。~Before handover check the records for completeness: measurements at every stage, raw closure and release data, the acceptance report and the disposition of every nonconformance; the operator surveys periodically against the baseline curve, computes residuals and follows the notification and inspection procedure when they exceed thresholds.
units.failure: 若合龍資料散失或只留下摘要，數十年後需要更換構件或補強時，工程師無法得知原始的鎖入力與合龍溫度，只能保守假設而增加成本，或錯誤假設而留下風險。~If closure data are lost or reduced to summaries, engineers replacing members or strengthening decades later cannot know the original locked-in forces and closure temperature, and must either assume conservatively at extra cost or assume wrongly and leave risk.
units.misconception: 合龍完成、橋梁通車後，施工階段的量測資料就沒有保存價值。~Once closure is complete and the bridge opens, construction-stage measurements are no longer worth keeping.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含合龍溫度與時間、合龍段尺寸、扣索卸載紀錄、驗收線形與應力、強迫對位紀錄與基準回歸曲線，並以可長期讀取的格式保存；營運手冊明訂殘差門檻與通報對象，由業主指定專責工程師管理。~Handover should include closure temperature and time, closure-segment dimensions, release records, acceptance geometry and stresses, forced-fit records and baseline regression curves in a long-term readable format; the operating manual sets residual thresholds and whom to notify, managed by an engineer the owner designates.

example: 合龍規劃練習：某鋼拱 L = 400 m、拱矢 f = 80 m、施工階段自重 w = 180 kN/m。成拱推力 H = w·L²/(8f) = 180×400²/(8×80) = 45,000 kN。合龍前每個半拱懸臂 200 m，拱腳彎矩 M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 180×200²/2 = 3.6×10⁶ kN·m；扣索力臂 50 m 時扣索力 T = 3.6×10⁶/50 = 72,000 kN。扣索長 250 m、斷面 0.08 m²、E = 195 GPa，彈性伸長 δ = 72×10⁶×250/(195×10⁹×0.08) ≈ 1.15 m，必須納入預拱與扣索長度設定。拱軸弧長 s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 400 + 8×80²/1,200 ≈ 442.7 m，溫度變化 10 °C 時合龍間隙改變 1.2×10⁻⁵×442.7×10 ≈ 53 mm，遠大於螺栓孔容許的數公釐，因此必須以實測溫度與間隙決定合龍段尺寸與鎖定時段。若拱矢提高到 100 m，推力降為 36,000 kN（減少 20%），但拱肋更長、溫度間隙變化與扣索高度都增加。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Closure-planning exercise: a steel arch has L = 400 m, rise f = 80 m and erection-stage self-weight w = 180 kN/m. The completed thrust is H = w·L²/(8f) = 180×400²/(8×80) = 45,000 kN. Before closure each half-arch cantilevers 200 m with a foot moment M = w·(L/2)²/2 = 180×200²/2 = 3.6×10⁶ kN·m; with a 50 m tieback lever arm the tieback force is T = 3.6×10⁶/50 = 72,000 kN. A 250 m tieback of 0.08 m² with E = 195 GPa stretches δ = 72×10⁶×250/(195×10⁹×0.08) ≈ 1.15 m, which must be built into camber and tieback length settings. The arc length is s ≈ L + 8f²/(3L) = 400 + 8×80²/1,200 ≈ 442.7 m, so a 10 °C change alters the closure gap by 1.2×10⁻⁵×442.7×10 ≈ 53 mm, far more than the few millimetres bolt holes allow, which is why measured temperature and gap must set the closure-piece size and locking window. Raising the rise to 100 m cuts thrust to 36,000 kN (20% less) but lengthens the ribs, increasing thermal gap change and tieback height. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 以懸臂方式架設大跨度鋼拱、再於拱頂合龍的做法在二十世紀初逐漸成熟。1930 年雪梨港灣大橋以兩岸岩盤隧道錨碇 128 條鋼索支撐半拱，逐步放鬆錨索讓兩半拱在 8 月 19 日接合；1976 年新河峽大橋以纜索吊運、油井套管背拉索與 16 具 1,250 噸液壓千斤頂下放合龍；2002 年上海盧浦大橋以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設 550 公尺拱跨並於 10 月合龍，之後重慶朝天門大橋把鋼桁拱跨度推到 552 公尺。這些案例的共同課題都是扣索控制、溫度窗口與體系轉換的量測驗證。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計或施工文件。~Cantilevering long-span steel arches and closing them at the crown matured in the early twentieth century. In 1930 Sydney Harbour Bridge held its half-arches back with 128 cables anchored in rock tunnels and gradually released them until the halves met on 19 August; in 1976 New River Gorge Bridge used a cableway, oil-well-casing tiebacks and sixteen 1,250-ton hydraulic jacks to lower its arms to closure; in 2002 Shanghai's Lupu Bridge cantilevered a 550 m arch on temporary cable stays and closed it in October, and Chongqing's Chaotianmen Bridge later pushed the steel truss arch span to 552 m. Common to all are tieback control, temperature windows and measured verification of the system change. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design or construction documents.
facts: 雪梨港灣大橋 503 公尺拱以 128 條錨碇鋼索懸臂架設，1930 年 8 月 19 日合龍~Sydney Harbour Bridge's 503 m arch was cantilevered on 128 anchored cables and closed on 19 August 1930
新河峽大橋 518 公尺拱於 1976 年 5 月以 16 具 1,250 噸千斤頂下放合龍~New River Gorge Bridge's 518 m arch was jacked down to closure in May 1976 with sixteen 1,250-ton jacks
新河峽大橋背拉索錨碇在推力座後方約 200 英尺的地錨中~New River Gorge Bridge's tiebacks were anchored in deadmen about 200 ft behind the abutments
上海盧浦大橋主拱跨度 550 公尺，以臨時斜拉索懸臂架設，2002 年 10 月合龍~Lupu Bridge in Shanghai has a 550 m arch, cantilevered on temporary stays and closed in October 2002
重慶朝天門大橋鋼桁拱主跨 552 公尺，2009 年通車~Chongqing's Chaotianmen Bridge has a 552 m steel truss arch span and opened in 2009
鋼的線膨脹係數約 1.2×10⁻⁵/°C，600 公尺鋼拱每 1 °C 伸縮約 7.2 mm~Steel expands about 1.2×10⁻⁵ per °C, so 600 m of arch changes about 7.2 mm per °C
大跨度鋼拱常見矢跨比約 1/4 至 1/6，新河峽大橋約 1:4.6~Long steel arches typically have rise-to-span ratios of about 1/4 to 1/6; New River Gorge is about 1:4.6
新河峽大橋纜索吊運跨距約 3,500 英尺，最重吊運約 92 噸~New River Gorge Bridge's cableway spanned about 3,500 ft, with a heaviest lift of about 92 tons
